api_contracts.purpose: Authenticate freshness device/session binding and replay before local policy.
api_contracts.authority: Paired controller Ed25519 public key plus active agent session
api_contracts.mutation: Records nonce in replay state only after verification.
api_contracts.error_behavior: Fail closed on malformed expired future-issued overlong wrong-device wrong-session invalid-signature or replayed envelopes.

api_contracts.purpose: Route automatically allowed structured capabilities or consume a trusted local approval for privileged capabilities.
api_contracts.authority: Local capability policy and local approval store
api_contracts.mutation: Read-only capabilities may auto-dispatch; privileged capabilities require one-use exact-request approval.
api_contracts.error_behavior: Unknown and shell capabilities deny; missing expired mismatched or replayed approvals fail closed.

api_contracts.purpose: Create a temporary pre-pairing device session.
api_contracts.mutation: Creates or rotates an unpaired in-memory session token.
api_contracts.error_behavior: Paired devices reject bootstrap session issuance.

api_contracts.purpose: Publish a one-use pairing offer that binds the device ID to its Ed25519 public key.
api_contracts.mutation: Stores hashed pairing code device key expiry and attempt count.
api_contracts.error_behavior: Mismatched device key existing pairing invalid TTL or unauthorized session reject.

api_contracts.purpose: Redeem a high-entropy pairing code and bind one controller Ed25519 public key to the device.
api_contracts.mutation: Creates pairing generation and invalidates bootstrap session.
api_contracts.error_behavior: Expired wrong replayed or exhausted codes reject.

api_contracts.purpose: Mint a short-lived paired device relay session.
api_contracts.authority: Device Ed25519 assertion bound to pairing generation and per-start agent session ID
api_contracts.mutation: Replaces active paired device session and records device assertion nonce.
api_contracts.error_behavior: Bad key stale generation expired/future assertion or replay rejects.

api_contracts.purpose: Mint a short-lived paired controller session.
api_contracts.authority: Controller Ed25519 assertion for current pairing generation plus active device session
api_contracts.mutation: Replaces controller session and records controller assertion nonce.
api_contracts.error_behavior: Bad key stale generation offline device expired/future assertion or replay rejects.

api_contracts.purpose: Queue a signed command for the active device session.
api_contracts.authority: Current paired controller session plus controller-signed CommandEnvelope
api_contracts.mutation: Adds one request to bounded queue and records command nonce.
api_contracts.error_behavior: Unauthorized controller malformed signature stale agent session duplicate request replayed nonce or full queue reject.

api_contracts.purpose: Long-poll fallback for the next FIFO command when WebSocket transport is disabled.
api_contracts.mutation: Leases only the FIFO head command for bounded time.
api_contracts.error_behavior: Expired rotated cross-device or pre-pairing sessions reject once paired; a leased head command cannot be bypassed by a later request.

api_contracts.purpose: Submit a result for a request owned by the authenticated paired device.
api_contracts.mutation: Completes queued request and stores bounded retained result.
api_contracts.error_behavior: Unknown requests and cross-device submissions reject.

api_contracts.purpose: Stream completed result as one SSE event.
api_contracts.authority: Current paired controller session bound to the active agent session
api_contracts.error_behavior: Unknown requests stale controller sessions and waits time out without fabricating results.

api_contracts.purpose: Append secret-safe structured security metadata to a bounded JSONL audit file.
api_contracts.mutation: Appends one validated event and fsyncs.
api_contracts.error_behavior: Symlink path invalid fields free-form values closed logger or size exhaustion reject.

api_contracts.purpose: Maintain a paired outbound device session, refresh it while an idle push transport is blocked, and execute verified structured commands through local policy approval executor and audit.
api_contracts.authority: Paired device identity plus paired controller public key and local policy
api_contracts.mutation: Creates fresh per-start agent session; may execute bounded local capability after required audit/approval.
api_contracts.error_behavior: Fail closed on session binding verification audit approval or hard transport failure; refresh on stale/expired paired sessions; remote payload cannot self-approve.

api_contracts.purpose: Bridge one provider-neutral tool call to a controller-signed relay command and return its result.
api_contracts.authority: Local controller Ed25519 private key plus current relay controller session
api_contracts.mutation: Queues one signed request and may refresh controller session after agent-session change.
api_contracts.error_behavior: Invalid JSON/session/auth failures reject; stale session refresh never reuses the stale request ID.

api_contracts.purpose: Run a bounded provider-neutral assistant/tool loop using only declared structured tools.
api_contracts.authority: Declared tool definitions and local controller executor
api_contracts.error_behavior: Unknown tools malformed JSON duplicate call IDs invalid tool results or round exhaustion fail closed.

api_contracts.purpose: Map provider-neutral messages and tools to an OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoint.
api_contracts.authority: Configured provider URL model and runtime API key
api_contracts.error_behavior: Non-loopback HTTP invalid config redirects malformed/oversized responses and malformed tool arguments reject.

api_contracts.purpose: Upgrade an authenticated paired-device outbound connection to a WebSocket command stream.
api_contracts.mutation: Leases only the FIFO head command, sends strict versioned stream framing around the unchanged signed CommandEnvelope, and waits for durable result completion before advancing.
api_contracts.error_behavior: Unauthorized or stale sessions reject before upgrade or close the stream; transport failures reconnect with bounded client backoff and do not weaken signed command verification.

data_contracts.name: Device identity seed
invariants: Ed25519 seed is 32 bytes.
Device ID is SHA-256-derived from public key.
Target path may not be a symlink.
Concurrent first-start converges on one identity.
POSIX group/other permissions are rejected.

data_contracts.name: Pairing
data_contracts.mutability: Ephemeral relay memory in current phase
invariants: Device public key must derive the device ID.
Controller public key is bound to one pairing generation.
Pairing codes are high entropy hashed expiring attempt-bounded and one-use.

data_contracts.name: Paired device session
data_contracts.retention: Until expiry replacement revoke or relay restart
invariants: Shared registration bootstrap cannot mint a paired-device session.
Assertion is generation-bound freshness-bounded nonce-protected and tied to an agent session ID.
Session token hash only is retained.

data_contracts.name: Paired controller session
data_contracts.retention: Until expiry device-session change pairing revoke replacement or relay restart
invariants: Controller session is device-generation-bound.
Controller session is bound to the active agent session ID.
Agent session rotation invalidates old controller authority.

data_contracts.name: Signed command queue
legal_writes: Current paired controller session presenting a valid controller-signed CommandEnvelope
data_contracts.retention: Until completion result eviction or relay restart
invariants: Envelope device and request IDs match route/request.
Envelope session ID equals active agent session.
Signature verifies against paired controller key.
Command nonce replay rejects.
Queue remains bounded per device.

data_contracts.name: Capability authorization
data_contracts.mutability: Source policy plus ephemeral local approval state
data_contracts.retention: Approval until one consume or expiry
invariants: Read list status and diff may auto-execute.
Write patch process and clone require trusted local approval.
Shell and unknown capabilities deny.
Approval binds request ID capability exact arguments and expiry and is consumed on first attempt.

data_contracts.name: Audit event
data_contracts.mutability: Append-only local file until configured bound
data_contracts.retention: Until external rotation/retention policy; append rejects at configured bound
invariants: No raw argument/token/stdout/stderr/free-form message fields exist.
Arguments may be represented only by SHA-256 digest.
Audit path symlinks reject.

data_contracts.name: Local agent pairing state
invariants: Device ID generation and controller public key are required.
Target path may not be a symlink.
POSIX group/other permissions reject.
Existing state is never silently overwritten.

data_contracts.name: Local controller pairing state
data_contracts.mutability: Created once after controller redeems pairing
invariants: Device ID and generation are required.
Target path may not be a symlink.
POSIX group/other permissions reject.
Existing state is never silently overwritten.

data_contracts.name: Provider runtime credential
invariants: max-chat does not persist the API key.
Non-loopback provider transport requires HTTPS.
Default provider client refuses redirects.

data_contracts.name: Encrypted relay durable state
data_contracts.mutability: Transactional encrypted snapshot when MAXRC_STATE_FILE and MAXRC_STATE_KEY are configured; explicit ephemeral mode remains available when both are unset
legal_writes: accepted paired device/controller assertion replay guard
completed result mutation and bounded eviction
paired device session rotation stale-command pruning
data_contracts.retention: Until explicit revoke/eviction or operator removes the encrypted state file; expired replay nonce records are discarded on load
invariants: The state encryption key is exactly 32 externally supplied bytes and is never serialized into durable state.
AES-256-GCM authenticates a versioned state envelope with fixed associated data.
Pairings generation counters queued commands request ownership completed retained results and unexpired replay nonces survive Store recreation.
Bearer device/controller sessions command leases pairing offers and pairing receipts are never persisted and must be re-established after relay restart.
The state path rejects symlinks non-regular files broad POSIX file permissions and group/other-writable POSIX parent directories.
Snapshot size is bounded and defaults to 64 MiB.
Snapshot schema is strict and validates device-key identity queue/result/request ownership and replay invariants before load and before save.
Durable mutation failure restores prior in-memory durable maps and does not acknowledge the mutation.

data_contracts.name: WebSocket command stream frame
legal_writes: Relay wraps one already-validated queued signed CommandEnvelope for paired-device delivery
data_contracts.retention: In flight only; command authority remains in the signed CommandEnvelope and durable relay queue
invariants: Stream version is exactly 1.
Type is command.
Request ID is bounded and must match the enclosed CommandEnvelope request ID at the agent client boundary.
Payload is valid JSON and remains the unchanged signed CommandEnvelope.
Transport framing is not command authority and cannot grant local approval.

ui_surfaces.name: Local terminal approval prompt
ui_surfaces.backend_authority: Local capability policy plus local approval store
forbidden_actions: accept approval asserted by remote payload
display raw write content by default

ui_surfaces.name: max-chat terminal client
ui_surfaces.backend_authority: Paired controller session plus provider-neutral chat core plus local PC-agent verification/policy
actions: pair one device via local stdin code

runbook_steps.name: Run race tests
runbook_steps.expected: all Go packages pass without detected data races

runbook_steps.name: Build binaries
runbook_steps.expected: agent relay and chat client build on current runner OS

runbook_steps.name: Configure durable relay state
runbook_steps.command: Set MAXRC_STATE_FILE to a protected local path and MAXRC_STATE_KEY to unpadded base64url of exactly 32 random bytes before launching max-relay
runbook_steps.expected: Both variables are configured together; relay loads or atomically updates encrypted durable state. If both are unset the relay starts in explicit ephemeral mode with a warning.
